name.description: Component slug, kebab-case. Used as the root of every node id in this spec (§5.5).

kind.description: What archetype of component this spec describes.

extends.description: Base spec slugs this component inherits from. Flattened at parse time; origin is retained in each node's envelope (§5.4/§11.2).

tokens.description: Path to the DTCG design-tokens file this spec's Style section's token-ref/layout-intent nodes were authored against.
